evidence: app/app/lib/pokeapi.server.ts:18 — `apiGet<T = any>`; API contract untyped, with `as any[]` casts at pokemon.tsx:60,141,150 and move.tsx:9, type.tsx:19, ability.tsx:9
app/app/root.tsx:7 — API_BASE_URL read here, again at pokeapi.server.ts:5, and hand-typed at urls.ts:6
app/app/lib/urls.ts:6 — useRouteLoaderData<{ apiBase: string }>("root") re-declares the root loader's type instead of deriving from ./+types/root
app/app/lib/pokeapi.server.ts:46 — dead duplicate spriteUrl (only urls.ts:9 is used, via components/ui.tsx:52)
app/app/root.tsx:65-74 — ErrorBoundary renders 'Not found' for every error including 500s, no isRouteErrorResponse/useRouteError discrimination
app/app/routes/home.tsx:35,37 — search text in component state seeded once from the URL; Back/Forward changes the URL but not the filter
churn_resistance.rationale: Data access is well contained in one module and loaders shape typed payloads, but the external API boundary is untyped and the API-origin/env plumbing is spread across three files with duplicates; the root error boundary conflates errors with not-found. An upgrade of the framework would ripple little, but an upstream API change would.

findings.issue: All API responses are typed `any` (`apiGet<T = any>` plus `as any[]` casts in every loader), so the PokeAPI contract is invisible to TypeScript; the spec explicitly allows the API data to change, so this will fail silently at runtime.
findings.suggestion: Define response interfaces (PokemonResource, SpeciesResource, TypeResource, …) in pokeapi.server.ts and type apiGet with them, keeping loaders honest about upstream shapes.

findings.issue: The root ErrorBoundary renders the 'Not found' UI for every error, including thrown 500s, conflating errors with not-found in one boundary.
findings.suggestion: Use `isRouteErrorResponse`/`useRouteError` to render a real error page for non-404s; keep the splat not-found route (routes.ts:14) for genuine 404s.

findings.issue: The search text lives in component state seeded once from the URL (lines 35, 37), so the URL is not the source of truth: Back/Forward navigation updates searchParams but leaves the input and the active filter stale.
findings.suggestion: Derive `q` from `searchParams` (deriving all four params from the URL), using a controlled input that syncs rather than shadow state.

findings.issue: API_BASE_URL is resolved in three places: root.tsx:7, pokeapi.server.ts:5, and the hand-written type at urls.ts:6, so changing origin handling touches all of them.
findings.suggestion: Centralise the origin in one module (e.g. urls.ts importing a single resolveApiBase), and derive the root loader type from ./+types/root instead of re-declaring it.

findings.issue: Dead duplicate `spriteUrl`; the live one is urls.ts:9 (used via components/ui.tsx:52), and the two can drift.
findings.suggestion: Delete the server-side spriteUrl and keep the pure helper in urls.ts (or make pokeapi.server import it).

findings.issue: Vite is locked to ^7 (resolves 7.3.7) although Vite 8 is the current major and @react-router/dev 8.5.1's peer range explicitly supports ^8.0.0 (package-lock.json:824-829).
findings.suggestion: Bump to `^8.0.0` (or track the @react-router template's Vite range) so the bundler stays on a supported major.

findings.issue: Mixed version pinning: exact '8.5.1' for react-router packages, exact 19.3.1 for React, but '^5' for isbot and '^7.0.0'/'^5.9.0' for dev tools.
findings.suggestion: Pick one policy (carets for all, or exact pins everywhere) so upgrades and lockfile audits are predictable.

findings.issue: Production build output is committed to the repo with no ignore rule for it.
findings.suggestion: Add `app/build/` (and `.react-router/`) to .gitignore; the harness runs `npm run build` itself.

findings.issue: The home loader returns the full 1025-species index (with per-species type English names) which is embedded in every SSR payload; reasonable for instant client-side filtering, but a large payload to carry indefinitely.
findings.suggestion: Project the index down for the client (e.g. send api names + ids and resolve display names client-side, or memoise a leaner shape) if payload size ever matters.

summary: A lean, fully current React Router 8.5.1 framework-mode app: root Layout + typegen + `data()` 404s are all the newest idioms, the dependency list is minimal with zero legacy packages, and the platform is used natively everywhere. The forward-looking debt sits in the untyped PokeAPI boundary, API-origin config spread across three files with dead duplicates, and a root ErrorBoundary that conflates errors with not-found. Framework upgrades would ripple almost nowhere; upstream API changes currently would not be caught by the compiler.

dependencies.note: 8.5.1; peer ranges already allow Vite 8 and TS 6/7, which the app under-uses.

dependencies.name: @react-router/serve
dependencies.note: Official minimal server adapter, still patched in 8.5.1; correct choice for a Node-serve target.

dependencies.name: isbot
dependencies.note: Not imported by app code, but required transitively by the framework's default server entry (app/build/server/index.js:5 imports isbot since the app ships no entry.server.tsx) — keep it, or drop it by providing your own entry.server.

dependencies.name: vite
dependencies.note: 7.3.7 works and is in the peer range, but Vite 8 is the current major; a planned bump keeps it from drifting two majors.
